title: Optimus Prime - Muscle Truck Program 【PPLPPL】
author: Ibrahim S.
desc:
《Not recommended for beginners.》
This is an advanced 6 days-a-week hypertrophy program focused on full-body development. 

《Progression》
Progress using double progression for the first top set of each exercise. Sets are added every two weeks.

ex.note: Incline should be less than 45°. Use a moderate arch and pause at the fully stretched position without letting the weight rest on your chest. Sets 2 and 3 are back off sets.
Deep stretch. Complete lockout is unnecessary but do it if you prefer it.
Use either a Smith machine or a barbell. Don't put the bench all the way up: Use 65-85° Incline. Warm up to a top set. Sets 2 and 3 are back off sets.
Swap with any type of lateral raises you prefer.
Narrow grip.
The first set is AMRAP. Match the second set to the first set using a myo-rep match.
Shoulder-width or narrower grip. Allow your scapula to fully protract at the top (fully stretch every muscle).
Focus on letting the scapula fully protract at the bottom and fully retract at the top.
Pronated grip. Slightly wider than shoulder width. Pull to the sternum, then to the chin when that is no longer possible.
Use whatever attachment you prefer. Long rope recommended.
EZ bar or cable. Deep stretch.
Push the elbows back on the eccentric.
Top set and back off set. Dead stop (i.e., fully rest the bar on the floor at the bottom). Heavy. Push the hips back and up in the lowering phase.
Lower the weight from the prior deadlifts. Touch and go ( i.e., do NOT let the bar rest on the floor). Use a deficit if needed.
You can substitute with leg press, Smith squat, or front squat. Use whatever you prefer.

ss.note: Try to get a deep stretch by putting the seat back. Complete lockout is unnecessary, but do it if you prefer.
Any type of body weight squat as long as the knees go past the toes.

ex.note: Any type of Calf Raise as long as the legs are straight.
Slightly wider than shoulder width grip. Swap with standard overhead press if it's uncomfortable.
By suppinating, you can get a deeper stretch of the anterior delt.
Rest a few minutes before starting. Wide grip. Slow eccentric.
Lengthened partials (i.e., don't bring the hands completely together). Go decently heavy on the first set.
Heavy. Top set and back off set.
Myo-rep match like last time.
Shoulder width grip. Hinge low (be parrallel with the floor if possible). Pull to the midpoint between the sternum and belly button. Don't pause at the top.
Chest supported T-Bar row. Use any other type of chest supported row if it's N/A.
Lean towards the arm you're pulling with to get a deeper lat stretch. Use a plate loaded machine if possible.
Use preferred attachment. Long rope recommended.
Lower the weight substantially on the last set and accumulate metabolites.
Narrower than shoulder width to target triceps.
Narrow stance. Elevate heels. Pause at the bottom.
Top set and back off set. Slow eccentric. Go all the way to the bottom.
Keep the seat forward and lean forward for a deeper stretch. Lengthened partials are allowed.
